decisions.decision: Dedicated edge-to-edge ebook reading surface. Quiet amethyst controls outside the original PDF page; paper, sepia and night modes, bottom navigation, automatic personal reading position. Preserve the PDF layout and adapt to viewport width by default.

Preserve amethyst glass and emoji. Chat occupies the full visible viewport, with collapsible session notes. Commerce uses the existing catalog artwork, a persistent cart, a master-only product/order console and agreed-payment orders. Prefer finite 150–400 ms opacity/transform animation; no continuous decorative rotations or animated blur. Respect reduced motion and the mobile keyboard.

Keep amethyst across all sections. Home previews original SVG worlds: surreal paper collage for cards, clay for party and strategy, handwritten notebook for RPG. Catalogs use soft materials; game boards intensify them without changing rules, suit colors or geometry. D&D sessions add medieval pixel-cut chrome. Reading uses bohemian stitched arches around unchanged PDF pages; shop uses faceted glass, preserving original product imagery. Headings use Caveat and Cormorant Garamond; controls retain Montserrat. Theme state resets on every destination, including direct game entry.

Use Nunito Sans throughout the interface, including section headings. Keep the original logo centered at entry and login without a duplicate white brand title. Remove decorative crystals and animated sparks, disable backdrop blur on common panels, remove the duplicate global stylesheet link, and show login methods directly after the portal. Preserve section materials, functional suit/chess glyphs and PDF content.
decisions.source: User requests, 2026-09-27; supersedes the earlier mixed display fonts.

decisions.decision: Supersedes previous collage, clay, bohemian, glass and Nunito Sans directions. Use 60% dark fantasy, 30% medieval core, 10% restrained maximalism throughout login, home, catalogs, games, D&D, reading, shop and account surfaces. Blackened violet, amethyst highlights, ivory type, engraved borders and original triptych art. Alegreya for readable UI and Unifraktur Maguntia for primary display titles. Preserve centered original login logo, no duplicate white brand title or decorative crystals. Preserve game geometry, suit colors, product images and PDF content. No continuous decorative animation or blur.

Latest user reference supersedes Gothic display typography: use hand-lettered poster design as the base throughout the amethyst platform. Bangers for expressive primary headings and game titles, Manrope for legible UI. Original ink-illustrated triptych, cream paper labels, irregular ink borders, subtle offset shadows and hand-drawn ornaments. Keep refined responsive layout, clear visual hierarchy and subdued functional surfaces. Preserve game geometry, PDF content and existing logo.

Extend the handwritten amethyst identity with an illustrated tavern entrance and reading nook, a dedicated Bottega department hub, and a shared-device card match counter. Use quiet high-contrast controls around gameplay and keep motion finite.

The Magic match view is a storybook tavern table: warm illustrated oak play surface, green felt player mats, full card faces placed on the table, playful hand-lettered labels and brass-like outlines. Preserve the existing gameplay controls and rules. Keep mobile card lanes swipeable, use finite interaction motion, and do not reproduce the official Magic card back or logos.

Favor a full-screen tavern tabletop over catalog-style panels: compact player-life HUD, one persistent turn dock, expandable game log and commander zone, full card faces at table size, a finite draw-to-hand animation, and mana icons from Scryfall Symbology. Keep hands horizontally swipeable, fullscreen escapable, and motion reduced when requested.

decisions.area: Magic collection, deck builder, match and scorekeeper
decisions.decision: Give the entire Magic section a pale white-and-amethyst claymorphism skin with soft raised/inset shadows, rounded panels and the existing comic Bangers/Manrope typography. Keep card faces, readable rules text, gameplay zones and mobile tap targets clear. Use the supplied Pokémon TCG Pocket screen recording only as a reference for compact mobile spacing, stacked collection/deck blocks and gentle light-blue/lilac surfaces; do not reuse its marks or art.
decisions.source: User request and supplied screen recording, 2026-10-10
